## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.1

First public alpha of PS5Save+, a fork of [PS5Save](https://github.com/heni0xyz/PS5Save) focused on everyday usability, clear backup feedback and straightforward configuration.

### What's included
- **Single payload:** `ps5saveplus_v0.1.0-alpha.1.elf` runs the backup service, web dashboard and one-time home-screen launcher installation.
- **Automatic backups:** decrypted and original PS4/PS5 saves, trophies, optional emulator directories and daily snapshots.
- **Cleaner notifications:** localised success/error alerts and adaptive progress updates on longer backups. Installer/setup Debug messages are in English.
- **Web dashboard:** live status, separate live-backup and snapshot explorers, file totals, history, logs and PS5-authorised configuration editing.
- **Automatic setup:** creates `ps5save-plus/backup.conf` on first run and migrates the older USB backup layout conservatively.
- **Process identification:** requests `ps5saveplus.elf` as the process name in Payload Manager.

### Installation
1. Use an exFAT USB drive with enough free space.
2. Launch `ps5saveplus_v0.1.0-alpha.1.elf` using a PS5 payload loader.
3. Open the installed PS5Save+ shortcut or visit `http://<PS5-IP>:8755/` on your trusted LAN.

**Alpha notice:** host regression tests and the PS5 SDK build passed. The dashboard and standalone shortcut have had initial console testing, but the **new combined ELF and integrated first-run installation still require validation**. Back up important saves separately before testing. Do not expose port 8755 to the internet.

Built using PS5 Payload SDK v0.50. Source and GPL-3.0 licence are available in this repository.
